hook.line: Most businesses are getting this massively wrong, and it's why ChatGPT isn't mentioning them.
hook.visual: Grimace and hand wave at a kitchen counter; red title box 'How AI search optimisation actually works in 2026' with sparkle emojis and a 'Part 2' tag

beats.what: Problem hook with a pained face, over the red 'Part 2' series title
Reframe: SEO alone doesn't get you mentioned by AI search; it's a full-suite effort
Lists the parts: PR and press mentions over links, reviews, Reddit reputation
Scolding aside: no moaning if you haven't done this work
Jump cut, leans into the lens: people used to go all in on one channel
Why that fails now: AI looks everywhere your brand is mentioned
Jump cut to the instruction: unify socials, PR and SEO
Jump cut to the takeaway: 'take one thing away from this video'
Don't ask your SEO team about AI visibility before talking about the other channels

why_it_works: 'You're getting this wrong' hook makes business owners check whether they are the ones doing it
Series title with 'Part 2' signals there is more, nudging profile visits and follows
Fast delivery (4.2 words/s) and expressive faces keep a plain kitchen shot moving
Explicit 'take one thing away' line packages the lesson for sharing with a team
weaknesses: Captions are tiny (caption-sized text only about a quarter of the time) and hard to read with sound off
No visuals for the channels she lists (PR, reviews, Reddit); everything is spoken
No CTA to Part 1 or Part 3 despite the series framing
Low loudness (-29.7 LUFS) makes the voice quiet next to other videos in the feed
for_robert: Brand reels as a numbered series with a fixed title card and 'Part N' tag; Fred could hold the part-number sign at the start of each episode.
